# Lantern, Bullseye (`equipment:lantern-bullseye`)
**Categories:** [Adventuring Gear](../equipment-categories/adventuring-gear.md) | **Cost:** 10 gp | **Weight:** 2 lb.

A Bullseye Lantern burns Oil as fuel to cast Bright Light in a 60-foot Cone and Dim Light for an additional 60 feet.
